main_figures.A2_sensitivity_heatmap: The only heatmap: optional 256×320 geometry, four survival/motion settings crossed with three gates and three limits. Each setting has four environment rows in L311,L314,W311,W314 order. Printed values are capped SciPy/method ratios, JVRUST left and CSGRAPH right. Values are individual environment observations, not pooled summaries.
main_figures.F11_rejection_lines: Uniform and congested-block rejection-limit sweeps. Linked upper panels show complete-call latency, lower panels the unmatched fraction from five saved validation cardinalities. Each line is one environment. The shaded block interval has K=144 throughout while native latency changes; no new solve determines these cardinalities.
main_figures.F1_overview_ccdf: Complementary empirical distributions of matching SciPy/method ratios. Each curve is one solver and one environment over its planned cases. Required natives n=102 and optional natives/sparse n=166; required JVX/JVS n=88 and optional JVX n=145. Linux is solid; Windows dashed. Ratios below the gray tie band are losses.
main_figures.F2_geometry_lines: Square geometry at q=0.9 and motion standard deviation 0.25δ. Required assignment is left; optional assignment with L=1.5δ and no gate is right. Top: complete-call milliseconds. Bottom: matching SciPy/method ratios. Each curve is one method/environment. JVX/JVS (required) and JVX/square SciPy (optional) are not planned above 1024 rows.
main_figures.F3_representations_strip: The 14 optional formulation workloads, with one marker per case/environment in each representation row. Ratios are capped SciPy/complete representation time. Filled Linux and open Windows markers preserve all observations; the congested-block workload at 256×320 is labelled.
main_figures.F4_policy_forest: Each row is an intervention, separated into four environment lanes. Markers are within-environment medians across eligible cases; thick bars are interquartile ranges and thin lines the full range. Parentheses give case counts. Ratios are intervention/release-policy time: above one is slower. Initializer bypass is a nominal intervention, not a budget value.
main_figures.F5_sparse_scatter: All 166 optional workloads for CSGRAPH and LAPMOD, separated by environment. Each point compares the same sparse complete-call time with capped SciPy (x) and JVRUST (y). Upper-right points beat both references. Graph construction is timed.
main_figures.F_structure_lines: Congestion, forbidden-entry and quantized-tie sweeps, required above and optional below. Each line is one native method/environment, and ordered x positions retain the generator sweep values. The marked case 041 contains the Windows JVRUST and Linux JVCPP losses. Wall time alone does not identify their internal work.

source_contract: Four saved light sessions only; each environment summarized separately; ratios classified with [0.97,1.03] tie band.
